dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical narrowing of the visible body mass from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-grey to white median pixel intensity across the dorsal surface.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A single dark, high-contrast punctate mark is visible near the center of the dorsal ridge.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A localized shadow-casting indentation is visible on the central longitudinal axis at the mid-body.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct dark mark or pit on the mid-dorsal ridge.
